# Matheus Abrahão — Full Bio and Work History

> Shopify expert and e-commerce engineer with 6+ years on the platform, scaling production Shopify operations for brands in the United States and Canada. Remote from São Paulo, Brazil (UTC-3). Client names are confidential and are referred to by category throughout this document.

Last updated: 2026-08-30.

---

## Origin Story

The Shopify work started with my own store.

At 16 I was building websites for clients, but I didn't just want to write code — I wanted to see how technical decisions move a real business. So I founded my own e-commerce brand, Martin (martin4shop.com.br). I built the entire Shopify stack from scratch, ran the marketing, shot the content, and operated the business end to end: 1,959 orders, roughly R$552,000 processed, and 299,000+ sessions, as a single founder.

That is where the operator mindset came from. I stopped thinking about code as output and started thinking about it as sessions, orders, AOV, and margin.

Since then I have expanded from running one store of my own to running Shopify operations for international brands — paired B2C and B2B storefronts on an enterprise-scale catalog for a US building-products manufacturer, an international luxury fashion brand where I was the sole engineer, and a US beauty and lifestyle brand. Same job, bigger catalogs.

## Work Experience

### Shopify Operator — US Building-Products Manufacturer (confidential)
**May 2026 – Present · United States · Remote · Full-time**

Operating paired B2C and B2B Shopify storefronts on one enterprise-scale catalog — multi-level variants, separate pricing and customer accounts, and 7+ sales channels.

- Catalog and data management: bulk updates, pricing adjustments, and inventory synchronization across multi-level variant configurations using Matrixify and complex CSV workflows.
- Retail syndication: catalog distribution through Salsify PIM to Lowe's, Home Depot (US and Canada), Menards, and Amazon Seller and Vendor Central, with MAP/MSRP pricing parity across every channel.
- Technical SEO and performance: structured data, schema markup, and site architecture for crawlability and AI-search readiness.
- Analytics and strategy: cross-referencing GA4 sales data to drive upselling, cross-selling, and merchandising decisions.
- Ecosystem stability: monitoring Shopify app integrations, resolving conflicts, building lead-capture forms, and optimizing navigation and checkout flow.

Technical partner and sole Shopify engineer, owning engineering, reliability and scalability for the brand's e-commerce ecosystem.

- Drove +455% platform sessions, +114% orders, and +74% total sales since joining, through technical optimization, SEO, and marketing integrations.
- Designed and implemented custom Liquid sections and UI logic, prioritizing Core Web Vitals and UX across a large product catalog.
- Led omnichannel integrations: Amazon Seller Central, Google Merchant Center, Meta Ads (CAPI and Pixel).
- Built and maintained Klaviyo flows for marketing, inventory, and post-purchase operations.
- Primary technical decision-maker in a fully remote, international environment.

## Working Style

- **Operator, not just developer.** I have run my own Shopify store end to end. Engineering decisions get made against sessions, orders, AOV, conversion rate and margin — not against a ticket count.
- **End-to-end ownership.** Architecture through production and ongoing operations. Comfortable as the sole engineer for a brand or as the technical partner inside a small team.
- **Timezone that actually works.** UTC-3 means near-full overlap with US business hours, Eastern through Pacific. Same-day replies, live calls, no overnight handoffs.
- **Bilingual.** Fluent English, native Portuguese. Effective in async writing and on live calls.
- **Client confidentiality.** Client names stay private; results are reported by brand category.
